summary.text: Sarah Mittelman is the Republican candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 49-Position 1, facing Democrat Kim Harless in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her campaign website describes her as a nurse and board-certified psychiatric mental health nurse practitioner with more than 20 years of experience.

paragraphs.text: Sarah Mittelman's campaign website describes her as a nurse, board-certified psychiatric mental health nurse practitioner, mother and community-based provider.
It says her work has included emergency care, psychiatric crisis response, behavioral health, addiction and homelessness.

Mittelman says on her site that she is running to bring practical leadership and accountability to Olympia, with a focus on affordability, public safety, behavioral health, transportation and thoughtful growth in Southwest Washington.
